title: Earthquakes from the USGS ComCat catalogue: time, place, depth and magnitude
provider: U.S. Geological Survey, Earthquake Hazards Program, FDSN event web service

week.description: The past seven days, magnitude 4.5 and above

month.description: The past 30 days, magnitude 4.5 and above

year.description: The past year, magnitude 6 and above

format: GeoJSON; coordinates are longitude, latitude (degrees, WGS 84) and depth (km); time in milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC
coverage: Global, from 1900 to the present; complete to magnitude 4.5 worldwide only in recent decades
citation: U.S. Geological Survey, Earthquake Hazards Program (2017). Advanced National Seismic System (ANSS) Comprehensive Catalog of Earthquake Events and Products. doi:10.5066/F7MS3QZH
